appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/benchmarking.md with correctness-gate semantics (ag/rust-ag parity divergence is hard-fail; cross-tool divergence is advisory) and required non-zero harness exit behavior when correctness gate fails.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit acceptance check that correctness-gate failures must propagate to non-zero CLI exits for benchmark harness modes (smoke/run/measured), including when cell error counts are zero.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The prior blocking issue in benchmark-harness-manifests-correctness-env came from missing CLI fail-state propagation despite correctness-gate failure detection.
